parameters.title: The heading displayed above the content.
parameters.subtitle: Supporting text shown with the main content.
parameters.child: The widget displayed inside this part.
parameters.initiallyExpanded: Whether the disclosure starts expanded when uncontrolled.
parameters.expanded: The controlled disclosure state, or null to manage it internally.
parameters.onExpansionChanged: Reports a request to expand or collapse the disclosure.
parameters.style: Overrides the component’s themed appearance for this instance.
parameters.enabled: Whether the part accepts user interaction.
